LanguageData.Gun_Ithaca_37_Stakeout_RWP.label: Ithaca 37 Stakeout
LanguageData.Gun_Ithaca_37_Stakeout_RWP.description: The Ithaca 37 Stakeout is a compact pump-action shotgun designed for close-quarters combat. With its rapid rate of fire and maneuverability, it's well-suited for tight spaces and quick reactions. Reliable and lethal, it excels in dispatching threats at short range.
